This event is recorded in the Book of Joshua, chapter 10, verses 12-13. The text states that the sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day, allowing the Israelites to defeat their enemies.

All three agents have identified Joshua as the answer with high confidence (0.92, 0.92, and 0.95), and this aligns with the biblical text. This is one of the most distinctive miraculous events in the Old Testament and is specifically associated with Joshua.
